credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/pitaya.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. COILED: one three-ribbed green stem segment with wavy, scalloped rib margins and 2px white areole tufts in the notches; short aerial roots grip the ground and the magenta-flushed young tip curls up and back over the body. The tip curls tighter, flings up and settles. Stem green in the dark slot, magenta-pink in the mid. Roots and the stem base stay fixed; only the signature part moves. Areoles are white tufts, never dark dots; the stamens are joined lines, never dots. Sport: the yellow pitaya (Selenicereus megalanthus), a related species with yellow fruit skin: the magenta mid slot turns yellow; geometry stays identical.
